verdict.rationale: Netlify explicitly documents team-level management of access, secrets, and env vars (netlify-docs-8), plus advanced security controls (netlify-docs-18) and REST API for programmatic management (netlify-docs-14). However there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific team-management workflow, and billing/access complaints (netlify-comm-3) hint at friction in team-level controls. Missing for 10: detailed docs on granular role-based permissions, independent verification of secrets management UX, and hands-on devops-lead accounts of team environment variable workflows.
